_comment: Slottable combat abilities. style is melee/ranged/magic/any. trigger_chance is a percent; cooldown_attacks counts player attacks, not seconds. Effect keys are exactly max_hit_percent, interval_percent, crit_chance_percent, apply_status (id from StatusEffect.TABLE), heal_on_hit_fraction. status_duration is a sibling of effect (seconds), only meaningful beside apply_status. Positive interval_percent is faster, matching ModifierKeys.ATTACK_INTERVAL_PERCENT.

power_strike.name: Power Strike
power_strike.description: A committed blow that hits 15% harder.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.description: Attacks 10% faster for a few swings.

gore.name: Gore
gore.description: Tears the target open, bleeding it for 6s.

precision_shot.name: Precision Shot
precision_shot.description: A careful shot that lands critical hits far more often.

envenom.name: Envenom
envenom.description: Coats the arrow, poisoning the target for 8s.

arcane_surge.name: Arcane Surge
arcane_surge.description: A raw surge of power: 25% harder and far more critical.

blood_pact.name: Blood Pact
blood_pact.description: Draws on vitality: heal for 15% of the damage dealt.
